Title: Public Preview: Secure by default with vault soft delete for Azure Backup

Body.Content: Secure by default with soft delete for Azure Backup enables you to recover your backup data even after it's deleted. With enabling soft delete at vault level, we are now providing secure by default promise for all customers where all the backup data will be recoverable by default for 14 days.
